title: DrivingLicence
description: A verification partner checked the holder's driving licence on the date in checkedAt. The front, back and portrait images appear only as SHA-256 hashes, split into two 128-bit halves; no image is in this credential.

givenName.title: givenName
givenName.description: Given name as printed on the licence

familyName.title: familyName
familyName.description: Family name as printed on the licence

issuingAuthority.title: issuingAuthority
issuingAuthority.description: Issuing authority as printed, for example RSA or a US state DMV. Optional

issuedAt.title: issuedAt
issuedAt.description: Date of issue, yyyymmdd (UTC). Optional: not every partner returns it

street.title: street
street.description: Street address as printed. Optional: only licences that print an address

city.title: city
city.description: City as printed. Optional: only licences that print an address

region.title: region
region.description: Region, county or state as printed. Optional: only licences that print an address

postalCode.title: postalCode
postalCode.description: Postal code as printed. Optional: only licences that print an address

addressCountry.title: addressCountry
addressCountry.description: Country of the printed address, ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, uppercase. Optional: only licences that print an address

sex.title: sex
sex.description: Sex as printed: M, F or X. Omitted when unknown

categories.title: categories
categories.description: Vehicle categories, comma-separated, upper case, for example AM,B,BE. Optional

heightCm.title: heightCm
heightCm.description: Height in centimetres, as printed. Optional

weightKg.title: weightKg
weightKg.description: Weight in kilograms, as printed. Optional

frontHashHi.title: frontHashHi
frontHashHi.description: First 128 bits of the SHA-256 of the front-of-licence image, 32 lower-case hex characters

frontHashLo.title: frontHashLo
frontHashLo.description: Last 128 bits of the SHA-256 of the front-of-licence image, 32 lower-case hex characters

backHashHi.title: backHashHi
backHashHi.description: First 128 bits of the SHA-256 of the back-of-licence image, 32 lower-case hex characters. Optional: single-sided licences have none

backHashLo.title: backHashLo
backHashLo.description: Last 128 bits of the SHA-256 of the back-of-licence image, 32 lower-case hex characters. Optional: single-sided licences have none

portraitHashHi.title: portraitHashHi
portraitHashHi.description: First 128 bits of the SHA-256 of the portrait image, 32 lower-case hex characters

portraitHashLo.title: portraitHashLo
portraitHashLo.description: Last 128 bits of the SHA-256 of the portrait image, 32 lower-case hex characters
